narrative.text:
ASHAVEL SWORN IN AS CHANCELLOR
Historic ceremony draws sixty thousand to Republic Square

Katerin Ashavel was sworn in as Chancellor of the Republic of Veltria this morning before the largest crowd in the history of Republic Square. Chief Justice Morin administered the oath at precisely eleven o'clock. The ceremony lasted forty minutes.

In her address to the nation, Chancellor Ashavel spoke directly to the Republic's divisions — acknowledging them without exploiting them. Political observers noted the absence of direct attacks on the Halvek legacy, calling it either statesmanship or strategic restraint depending on their perspective.
Markets opened flat following the ceremony. The kroner held steady against the Arcturian currency. Analysts described investor sentiment as cautiously watchful.
Former Chancellor Halvek was not present at the ceremony. His office issued no statement.
